question: What were net sales in euros by system this year?
query: SELECT r.system, CAST(SUM(i.net_invoice_value / br.rate * er.rate) AS decimal(18,0)) AS net_sales_eur FROM SpaceParts.invoices i JOIN SpaceParts.invoice_doc_type d ON d.billing_document_type_code = i.billing_document_type_code AND d.[group] = 'Invoice' JOIN SpaceParts.budget_rate br ON br.from_currency = i.local_currency JOIN SpaceParts.exchange_rate er ON er.from_currency = i.local_currency AND er.rate_type = 'Monthly Rate' AND CAST(er.[date] AS date) = i.billing_date JOIN SpaceParts.customers c ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key JOIN SpaceParts.regions r ON r.station = c.station WHERE i.billing_date >= '2022-01-01' GROUP BY r.system ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC

question: Which account managers are furthest behind budget this year?
query: WITH actual AS (SELECT c.account_manager, SUM(i.net_invoice_value / br.rate * er.rate) AS actual_eur FROM SpaceParts.invoices i JOIN SpaceParts.invoice_doc_type d ON d.billing_document_type_code = i.billing_document_type_code AND d.[group] = 'Invoice' JOIN SpaceParts.budget_rate br ON br.from_currency = i.local_currency JOIN SpaceParts.exchange_rate er ON er.from_currency = i.local_currency AND er.rate_type = 'Monthly Rate' AND CAST(er.[date] AS date) = i.billing_date JOIN SpaceParts.customers c ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key WHERE i.billing_date >= '2022-01-01' AND i.billing_date < '2022-08-01' GROUP BY c.account_manager), budget AS (SELECT c.account_manager, SUM(b.total_budget) AS budget_eur FROM SpaceParts.budget b JOIN SpaceParts.customers c ON c.customer_key = b.customer_key WHERE b.[month] >= '2022-01-01' AND b.[month] < '2022-08-01' GROUP BY c.account_manager) SELECT TOP 10 b.account_manager, CAST(COALESCE(a.actual_eur, 0) AS decimal(18,0)) AS actual_eur, CAST(b.budget_eur AS decimal(18,0)) AS budget_eur, CAST(COALESCE(a.actual_eur, 0) - b.budget_eur AS decimal(18,0)) AS gap_eur, CAST(100.0 * (COALESCE(a.actual_eur, 0) / b.budget_eur - 1) AS decimal(9,1)) AS gap_pct FROM budget b LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.account_manager = b.account_manager ORDER BY gap_eur ASC

question: How did net sales grow against last year by interplanetary region?
query: WITH s AS (SELECT r.interplanetary_region, YEAR(i.billing_date) AS yr, SUM(i.net_invoice_value / br.rate * er.rate) AS net_sales_eur FROM SpaceParts.invoices i JOIN SpaceParts.invoice_doc_type d ON d.billing_document_type_code = i.billing_document_type_code AND d.[group] = 'Invoice' JOIN SpaceParts.budget_rate br ON br.from_currency = i.local_currency JOIN SpaceParts.exchange_rate er ON er.from_currency = i.local_currency AND er.rate_type = 'Monthly Rate' AND CAST(er.[date] AS date) = i.billing_date JOIN SpaceParts.customers c ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key JOIN SpaceParts.regions r ON r.station = c.station WHERE (i.billing_date >= '2022-01-01' AND i.billing_date <= '2022-08-21') OR (i.billing_date >= '2021-01-01' AND i.billing_date <= '2021-08-21') GROUP BY r.interplanetary_region, YEAR(i.billing_date)) SELECT cy.interplanetary_region, CAST(cy.net_sales_eur AS decimal(18,0)) AS ytd_2022_eur, CAST(py.net_sales_eur AS decimal(18,0)) AS same_period_2021_eur, CAST(100.0 * (cy.net_sales_eur / py.net_sales_eur - 1) AS decimal(9,1)) AS growth_pct FROM s cy JOIN s py ON py.interplanetary_region = cy.interplanetary_region AND py.yr = 2021 WHERE cy.yr = 2022 ORDER BY growth_pct DESC

question: What were net sales in euros for each key account last year?
query: SELECT c.key_account_name, CAST(SUM(i.net_invoice_value / br.rate * er.rate) AS decimal(18,0)) AS net_sales_eur FROM SpaceParts.invoices i JOIN SpaceParts.invoice_doc_type d ON d.billing_document_type_code = i.billing_document_type_code AND d.[group] = 'Invoice' JOIN SpaceParts.budget_rate br ON br.from_currency = i.local_currency JOIN SpaceParts.exchange_rate er ON er.from_currency = i.local_currency AND er.rate_type = 'Monthly Rate' AND CAST(er.[date] AS date) = i.billing_date JOIN SpaceParts.customers c ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key WHERE c.account_type = 'Key Account' AND i.billing_date >= '2021-01-01' AND i.billing_date <= '2021-08-21' GROUP BY c.key_account_name ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC
